item.hellfire.throw_hint: Hold use to charge, then release to throw. Not consumed.
item.hellfire.missile_strike.tooltip: Thrown red flare. A red beam marks the spot and a missile comes down for one large explosion.
item.hellfire.nuclear_strike.tooltip: Thrown yellow flare. A bomber flies over and drops one nuclear bomb. Larger blast, then about a minute of radiation.
item.hellfire.napalm_strike.tooltip: Thrown orange flare. A plane drops a line of fire that keeps burning. No crater.
item.hellfire.bombing_run.tooltip: Thrown blue flare. A plane drops a short line of bombs.
item.hellfire.radio.tooltip: Right-click to fly a plane. WASD and look steer. Sneak descends. Jump gets off on the ground below.
item.hellfire.radio.tooltip2: Use drops the selected bomb. Sneak-use cycles bombs, napalm, missile, or one nuclear bomb.
message.hellfire.ordnance_nuclear: Nuclear bomb armed. One drop, then it cools down.
